question: According to World Bank, what was the density of the population of Sri Lanka in 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**354 Persons per sq. km.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka** is a small island nation located in** South Asia **and has a total area of around **65,610 square kilometers.**
 
• The population of **Sri Lanka in 2020** was estimated to be around **21.4 million.**
 
• Therefore, the population density of Sri Lanka in 2020 was around **354 persons per square kilometer.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The term **"population density" **refers to the number of people living in a particular area, usually measured **per square kilometer or square mile.**
 
• Sri Lanka has a relatively** high population density** compared to other countries in the region, such as India and Bangladesh.
